# orionbelt_permission (Resource)

One standing access grant: a user on a machine. Do not combine with orionbelt_machine_access on the same machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orionbelt_permission" "deploy" {
  user_id      = orionbelt_user.engineer.id
  machine_id   = data.orionbelt_machine.web.id
  access_type  = "ssh"
  remote_users = ["deploy"]
  expires_at   = "2027-01-31T00:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_type` (String) ssh, scp, both, rdp, vnc or k8s.
- `machine_id` (String)
- `user_id` (String)

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the grant stops working. Null means never.
- `remote_users` (Set of String) Accounts on the target (or namespace/role scopes for k8s).

### Read-Only

- `granted_at` (String) When the grant last changed. The gateway resets it on every update.
- `granted_by` (String) Who last changed the grant. The gateway resets it on every update.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a grant as <machine_id>/<permission_id>.
terraform import orionbelt_permission.deploy <machine_id>/<permission_id>
```
